title: Parlament am Franzensring in Wien
description: A vintage colored postcard showing the Austrian Parliament Building (Parlament) on the Franzensring in Vienna, Austria, with a handwritten date of 18-12-06.

title: Greetings from Turkestan (Поклонъ изъ Туркестана)
description: An undivided back postcard illustrated with vignettes of traditional Central Asian transportation including a high-wheeled arba cart, camels, and horseback riders, mailed from Tashkent in 1900.

title: Venezia - Grand Canal and Rialto Bridge
description: A picturesque view of the Grand Canal in Venice bustling with gondolas and boats, with the iconic Rialto Bridge in the background under a clear blue sky.

title: Iasi Universitatea
description: Historical postcard depicting the main building of Alexandru Ioan Cuza University in Iași, Romania, with a monument in the foreground.

title: Bucharest, CEC Palace & Grand Hotel
description: A vintage colored postcard showing the CEC Palace and the Grand Hotel du Boulevard on Calea Victoriei in Bucharest, Romania. The street scene includes pedestrians and horse-drawn carriages.

title: Școala Laurian, București
description: Historical postcard showing the Laurian School building in Bucharest with handwritten messages in Romanian.

title: Palatul Printului Sturza, Bucharest
description: A vintage postcard featuring the ornate Sturza Palace in Bucharest, with details of its elaborate architecture and a street scene with pedestrians. The postcard is postally used with two Romanian stamps.

title: University Square, Bucharest
description: A vintage monochrome postcard showing University Square in Bucharest, Romania, featuring modernist and neoclassical architecture.

title: Palatul Regal, Bucuresti
description: Historical postcard showing the Royal Palace in Bucharest (Palatul Regal) with its front courtyard, garden, and fountain.

title: Foișorul de Foc, Bucharest, Romania
description: A vintage postcard depicting the Foișorul de Foc (The Fire Tower) in Bucharest. The card was postally used in 1903 and published by Ad. Maier & D. Stern.

title: București, Piața Senatului
description: A vintage sepia postcard showing the busy Piața Senatului in Bucharest, with prominent buildings like the Palace of the Senate and the Adriatica-Trieste Palace, along with period vehicles like trams and cars.

title: Ateneul Român (Romanian Athenaeum), Bucharest
description: A vintage postcard featuring the Romanian Athenaeum, a famous concert hall in Bucharest, surrounded by its park. The image captures the grandeur of the building and its green surroundings.

title: București - Grădina Cișmegiu
description: Color tinted vintage postcard showing promenading visitors along a pathway by the lake in Cișmigiu Gardens, Bucharest.

title: Sinaia - Gara
description: Panoramic view of the railway station complex and tracks in Sinaia, Romania, set against the forested Carpathian hillside.

title: Brașov - Kronstadt with the Black Church
description: Vintage black and white postcard offering an elevated panoramic view over the historic center of Brașov (Kronstadt), centered on the Gothic Black Church (Biserica Neagră).

title: Nagyvárad, Emke Café and Szigligeti Theatre
description: A sepia-toned postcard showing the cityscape of Nagyvárad (Oradea), featuring the Emke Café, Szigligeti Theatre, and the surrounding square with horse-drawn carriages.

title: Nagyvárad, Körösparti részlet
description: Black and white postcard showing the Crișul Repede (Sebes-Körös) river in Nagyvárad (Oradea), with several prominent buildings on the bank, including the City Hall tower, the Financial Palace, and the Szent László Bridge.

title: Postcard of Peleș Castle, Sinaia, Romania
description: A black and white postcard showing a view of Peleș Castle from a grassy hillside, sent from Sinaia, Romania to Coblenz, Germany in 1907.

title: Salutări din România - Sinaia
description: Vintage lithographic postcard depicting a panoramic view of Sinaia and the Bucegi Mountains with an undivided front message area.

title: Constanța - Cazinul.
description: A colorized postcard depicting a panoramic view of the Constanța Casino on the Black Sea coast, with the Genovese Lighthouse in the foreground.

title: La fortul Otopeni. Manevrele regale
description: Black and white historical postcard showing royalty and military officers observing royal military maneuvers at Fort Otopeni near Bucharest, circa 1895.

title: HUNEDOARA - Castelul Huniazilor
description: Black and white postcard view of the dramatic Corvin Castle (Hunyadi Castle) in Hunedoara, Romania, highlighting the iconic tall conical towers and Gothic rooflines.

title: Castelul Huniazilor, Hunedoara
description: Black and white vintage postcard showing a view of the towers and ramparts of Corvin Castle (Castelul Huniazilor) in Hunedoara, Romania.

title: Stockholm Waterfront and Gamla Stan Skyline
description: A scenic view across the water showing the historic Skeppsbron waterfront, boats moored along the quay, and the German Church (Tyska kyrkan) spire in Stockholm.

title: Greetings from Los Angeles, California
description: A classic 'Large Letter' linen postcard from Los Angeles, California. Each letter of 'LOS ANGELES' contains a different iconic scene from the city and its surroundings.

title: Empire State Building, New York City
description: A classic linen-era postcard showcasing the Empire State Building as it towers over the surrounding Midtown Manhattan cityscape, printed by Curt Teich & Co.

title: Burns Cottage and Monument Ayr Christmas Postcard
description: A vintage colorized postcard featuring a portrait of Robert Burns, Burns Cottage, and Burns Monument in Ayr, Scotland, with a handwritten Christmas and New Year greeting.

title: Souvenir de Paris 1900 - Paris La Tour Eiffel
description: Artistic souvenir postcard from 1900 featuring an elevated panoramic view of the Eiffel Tower and the 1900 Paris Exposition Universelle grounds within an ornate decorative border.

title: Aerial Panorama of Place de l'Étoile, Paris
description: An early 20th-century aerial photograph of the Place de l'Étoile (now Place Charles de Gaulle) in Paris, featuring the Arc de Triomphe at its center. The photo was taken from a balloon at an altitude of 700 meters.

title: Panorama of Avenue d'Iéna and Kléber, Paris
description: A panoramic view of Paris from the Arc de Triomphe, looking towards the Eiffel Tower. The tree-lined Avenue d'Iéna is on the left and Avenue Kléber is on the right. A group of people in period attire observe the view from the balcony.

title: Paris — La Tour Eiffel
description: A colorized postcard depicting the Eiffel Tower as viewed from the Jardins du Trocadéro, with the Champ de Mars and the Grande Roue de Paris visible in the background.

title: Notre-Dame de Lorette Chapel, Paris
description: A print showing the first chapel named Notre-Dame de Lorette in Paris, built before 1646 and destroyed in 1800. It includes a drawing of the chapel, a map from 1778, and historical notes.
